'''Larken''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who owned the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Pillage]]''. During his career as a pirate he at one stage worked with two other pirate vessels named ''[[Trust Me]]'' and [[Profit (pirate ship)|''Profit'']], the latter of which was [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by an individual named [[Druug]], in [[Ambush near Darknon Station|attempted]] to capture the [[Helix-class light interceptor|''Helix''–class light interceptor]], ''[[Kizbon's Box]]'', based a on tip from a female named [[Sahr]] whom Larken paid for the information. With Sahr as his gunner, Larken and his fellow pirates positioned themselves near the [[Space station/Legends|space station]], [[Darknon Station]] under the cover of a [[Ion storm/Legends|magnetic storm]] in preparation to ambush their target. When the ''Box'' arrived the three ships moved in on the supposedly unarmed target with Larken thirsting to spill some [[Blood/Legends|blood]]. The group were horrified to find their mark had several hidden armaments including [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedos]], with which it destroyed ''Trust Me'' and ''Profit'' before it's [[Unidentified pilot (Kizbon's Box)|owner]] [[Comlink/Legends|commed]] Larken and Sahr in the ''Pillage'', addressing them both by name.<ref name="ABGTAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Larken first appeared in [[1995]] the article "[[A Buyer's Guide to Alternative Starships]]" which was published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5|fifth]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' series of supplement books for [[West End Games]], ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The article was written by [[Stephen Luminati]] and included two short stories to illustrate some of the ships mentioned. Larken appeared as the main character in one of these, titled "''Kizbon's Box''" which gave no information as to what era it was set in.
